conclusion: The original form/cookie, Bearer-alternative, validation-error and binary-media mismatches are locally corrected. This is a bounded contract review, not proof of every endpoint workflow.

commands.result: Complete backend API contract matches its reviewed snapshot
Mobile OpenAPI contract matches the reviewed snapshot

acceptance_mapping.form_and_response: Login advertises only application/x-www-form-urlencoded; AuthResponse exposes user/status/expiry and tokens are HttpOnly cookies.
acceptance_mapping.security: Dependency traversal marks dashboard HTTPBearer OR DashboardAccessCookie; refresh separately documents HttpOnly refresh cookie OR required body credential; body optionality and precedence match handler. Mobile routes remain on their original dependencies.
acceptance_mapping.csrf: Cookie CSRF metadata now explicitly applies when no Bearer header is supplied, matching runtime bypass semantics.
acceptance_mapping.validation_errors: Generated FastAPI HTTPValidationError422 is replaced with ApiErrorResponse;15-case lane includes actual ASGI error responses validated by that response model, correlation and legacy/header behavior.
acceptance_mapping.files: AST inventory of every registered-style route function using StreamingResponse/FileResponse/private_object_streaming_response found no direct file implementation lacking binary_responses. Representative XLSX/image/CSV and range metadata assertions pass.
acceptance_mapping.drift: Complete and existing mobile snapshots checked after regeneration; CI rejects any unreviewed drift, including breaking changes. Intentional changes require manual review of the generated diff.

limitations: No assertion of automated semantic backward-compatibility analysis; snapshot equality detects drift and code review classifies compatibility.
No new physical mobile-device or native behavior test was performed. The mobile change is a backend-generated approved contract artifact.

File metadata was checked against route source and schema assertions; this narrow15-case lane does not itself execute every file transport route. Existing joined/service tests supply separate workflow evidence.
Real GitHub CI execution and production deployment are not asserted.

description_only_change.auth.py: Refresh Origin/Referer description now qualifies when no Bearer header is supplied.
description_only_change.openapi_contract.py: Same qualification added to access-cookie/refresh-cookie descriptions and both x-cookie-csrf metadata values; no authentication logic changed.
